s: October 3, 2019 - Hardy to USDA Zone 6 (minimum temperature -10 degrees F), or perhaps even lower, fern-leaf full moon maple grows best in rich, moist, well-drained soil, in sun or part shade. However, it’s somewhat tolerant of sand and clay. Fall color is best in full sun or open shade. With increasing shade, the colors will be more subtle – orange and yellow with touches of red. Here in the Pacific Northwest, it’s one of the most reliable trees to develop fall color.
